episodes.title: 1st Quarter
episodes.summary: Years after bad boy QB Russ Holliday nuked his college football career, he attempts to walk on to the struggling South Georgia Catfish program disguised as a young man named Chad Powers.

episodes.title: 2nd Quarter
episodes.summary: Chad struggles to compete for the starting QB job then struggles even more maintaining his new identity at Coach Hudson's lake house barbecue.

episodes.title: 3rd Quarter
episodes.summary: It's the second half of the season opener against Ole Miss and the Catfish are losing. Stuck on the sidelines together, Chad and Ricky team up and try to save the day.

episodes.title: 4th Quarter
episodes.summary: The night before an away game in Knoxville, Russ and Danny must sneak out of the team hotel and go on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

episodes.title: 5th Quarter
episodes.summary: The Catfish are 5-0. Chad Powers is a superstar, and ESPN wants to feature him on College Gameday. What could go wrong?

episodes.title: 6th Quarter
episodes.summary: On the eve of the biggest game of the season, the truth about Chad Powers threatens to emerge.

episodes.title: 7th Quarter
episodes.summary: Russ and Danny's tenuous new alliance with Ricky is tested when Chad suffers a mid-game injury.

episodes.title: 8th Quarter
episodes.summary: Ahead of the team's big bye week house party, Coach Hudson grows increasingly suspicious of Chad's behavior.

episodes.title: 9th Quarter
episodes.summary: With the Catfish stranded in the airport after a tough away game, Tricia cozies up to Chad – and starts asking dangerous questions.

episodes.title: 10th Quarter
episodes.summary: To legitimize his backstory, Russ brings his real father to the Catfish homecoming banquet as Chad's dad – Howard Powers.

episodes.title: 11th Quarter
episodes.summary: Gerry pursues the truth about Chad Powers, while Russ, Ricky, and Danny do everything they can to stop him.

episodes.title: 12th Quarter
episodes.summary: Chad and the Catfish must beat Texas to make the Playoff, but Gerry has other plans.
